name: TK-Planes
definition: A NeRF-based architecture for dynamic UAV scenes that stores tiered feature vectors in grids rather than RGB values, using an image decoder to transform feature maps into final RGB images.
summary: TK-Planes is a neural rendering architecture for dynamic scenes that decouples volumetric feature accumulation from image synthesis using tiered feature grids and a multi-stage decoder to improve speed and fidelity.
